deep_dive_report.report_title: Deep Dive OON Analysis - Commercial Individual (MCM006) - R12

detail_statements: Out of Total claims count 463,568, NPAR Claims count percentage increased by 22.98% and PMPM ratio increased by 148.54% for R12 period.
In GA, out of 463,568 total claims(for R12), 380,695(82.12%) were NPAR, resulting in $430,971,928.45 in OON payments.

In GA, out of 23,324 total NPAR claims for Provider GRADY MEMORIAL HOSPITAL under the HMO product, 49.50% were processed as PAR over the past 12 months. This pattern indicates potential network configuration improvement opportunities (e.g., provider/network assignment or adjudication setup).
In GA, IDR claims represented 81.19% of total OON claims, indicating an upward trend in dispute activity relative to overall OON volume.
In GA, out of 380,695 total NPAR claims, 309,100 (81.19%) were flagged for IDR, representing a 18.76% increase from the prior period.
Among the 309,100 IDR-flagged claims, the top providers are NGMC GAINESVILLE, GRADY MEMORIAL HOSPITAL, PIEDMONT HENRY HOSPITAL.
For NGMC GAINESVILLE, 100.00% of claims were processed as PAR for the HMO product over the past 12 months, indicating potential network configuration issues.
For GRADY MEMORIAL HOSPITAL, 50.00% of claims were processed as PAR for the HMO product over the past 12 months, indicating potential network configuration issues.
For PIEDMONT HENRY HOSPITAL, 100.00% of claims were processed as PAR for the HMO product over the past 12 months, indicating potential network configuration issues.
Out of Total claims count 264,206, NPAR Claims count percentage increased by -20.52% and PMPM ratio increased by 5.89% for R12 period.
In IN, out of 264,206 total claims(for R12), 218,427(82.67%) were NPAR, resulting in $296,067,295.29 in OON payments.

In IN, out of 27,273 total NPAR claims for Provider SIDNEY AND LOIS ESKENAZI HOSPITAL under the FFS product, 100.00% were processed as PAR over the past 12 months. This pattern indicates potential network configuration improvement opportunities (e.g., provider/network assignment or adjudication setup).
In IN, IDR claims represented 64.26% of total OON claims, indicating an upward trend in dispute activity relative to overall OON volume.
In IN, out of 218,427 total NPAR claims, 140,352 (64.26%) were flagged for IDR, representing a -14.45% increase from the prior period.
Among the 140,352 IDR-flagged claims, the top providers are SIDNEY AND LOIS ESKENAZI HOSPITAL, COMMUNITY HOSPITAL EAST.
For SIDNEY AND LOIS ESKENAZI HOSPITAL, 100.00% of claims were processed as PAR for the FFS product over the past 12 months, indicating potential network configuration issues.
Out of Total claims count 140,626, NPAR Claims count percentage increased by 635.66% and PMPM ratio increased by 25.28% for R12 period.
In TX, out of 140,626 total claims(for R12), 133,485(94.92%) were NPAR, resulting in $63,339,016.04 in OON payments.
In TX, no PAR_MATCH_SAME_PRODUCT data available for configuration issue analysis.
In TX, IDR claims represented 88.71% of total OON claims, indicating an upward trend in dispute activity relative to overall OON volume.
In TX, out of 133,485 total NPAR claims, 118,416 (88.71%) were flagged for IDR, representing a -0.08% increase from the prior period.
Among the 118,416 IDR-flagged claims, the top providers are GRADY MEMORIAL HOSPITAL, NGMC GAINESVILLE, SIDNEY AND LOIS ESKENAZI HOSPITAL.

NGMC GAINESVILLE shows a recurring PAR/OON reimbursement overlap for the same provider and facility service types, indicating inconsistent network assignment and potential provider configuration gaps. Psychoses and Cirrhosis and Alcoholic Hepatitis with CC account for approximately 80% of total OON reimbursements for NGMC GAINESVILLE.
No professional service type (PHYSN/PANCL) data available for the top 5 providers in this analysis period.
For NGMC GAINESVILLE, IDR claims represented 98.66% of NPAR claims for facility services, indicating elevated dispute activity.
